name: Serenity
zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit: $AXTI is still the chokepoint of the optical buildout with fast growing InP substrate demand and LTAs with $LITE and $COHR; he watches for a $SNDK style price hike, with channel checks showing 50 to 60% in Q2 2026, 10% in Q3 and 10%+ in Q4, though Coherent's SEC offering hints at a price ceiling.
en_summary: @aleabitoreddit: $AXTI is still the chokepoint of the optical buildout with fast growing InP substrate demand and LTAs with $LITE and $COHR; he watches for a $SNDK style price hike, with channel checks showing 50 to 60% in Q2 2026, 10% in Q3 and 10%+ in Q4, though Coherent's SEC offering hints at a price ceiling.
text:
$AXTI still the chokepoint of the entire optical buildout + demand for InP substrates will grow a lot. 

They have LTA supply agreements to $LITE / $COHR and probably ends up #1 vs. Sumitomo Electric.

The main thing I'm watching is if they can pull a $SNDK style price hike. So far from some channel checks: 

- Q2 2026: 50-60% increase
- Q3 2026: 10% increase
- Q4 2026: 10%+ hike

But from Coherent's SEC offering... it does look like there's a ceiling to how high % prices can go, which makes that case less likely. 

We'll see how it plays out

name: Sawyer Merritt
zh_summary: @SawyerMerritt: Tesla registered another 32 Cybercabs, 43 today in total, bringing the Texas DMV total to 465. $TSLA
en_summary: @SawyerMerritt: Tesla registered another 32 Cybercabs, 43 today in total, bringing the Texas DMV total to 465. $TSLA
text:
Tesla just registered another 32 Cybercabs for its Robotaxi fleet, bringing the total number of Cybercabs registered to date to 465, according to the Texas DMV.

Including the 11 earlier, Tesla registered a total of 43 Cybercabs today.

name: Serenity
zh_summary: @aleabitoreddit: $AAOI is expanding laser manufacturing by 350% yet cannot make enough lasers for its own pluggable transceivers, so it turned away hyperscalers for CPO lasers; he would shift to CPO lasers and buy from merchants like $SIVE.
en_summary: @aleabitoreddit: $AAOI is expanding laser manufacturing by 350% yet cannot make enough lasers for its own pluggable transceivers, so it turned away hyperscalers for CPO lasers; he would shift to CPO lasers and buy from merchants like $SIVE.
text:
$AAOI is the perfect example. They're expanding laser manufacturing at 350%. 

But they said they can't produce enough lasers to even meet their own pluggable transceiver demand. So they had to turn away hyperscalers for CPO lasers. 

TBH if I were AOI, I'd reallocate toward CPO lasers and then buy lasers off merchant players like $SIVE.

But I guess they want to be end-to-end vertically integrated.
